summary: Regression fix VERIFIED at 375x667. Registered fresh user, added a Quick Task from Today tab: task-input accepted text, add-task button tapped WITHOUT force=True (natural click succeeded, no overlay interception), a new task-row appeared with the entered title, and the active tab remained Today (recall-front from Review not rendered). Bounding-box check post scroll-into-view of add-task shows a 246px gap above the bottom Nav — no overlap. Sanity: tab-focus renders AMBIENT SOUND label and sound-white chip; tab-plan renders add-schedule button. No layout breakage from the ScrollView flex:1/marginBottom:76 change.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is a single 94-line file with extremely long lines (multiple screen components inline). While functional, splitting Today/Plan/Focus/Review into separate files would aid maintainability. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Registered two ephemeral users (qa2+<ts>@example.com and qa2+<ts>b@example.com) each with one task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 93: styles.scroll = { flex:1, marginBottom:76 } and styles.content paddingBottom:32. Bottom Nav (absolute, height 76) no longer overlays ScrollView content. Verified at 375x667 by measuring add-task bounding box vs tab-review bounding box (nav top y=602, add-task bottom y=356 -> 246px gap) and by clicking without force=True.
rca_of_issue: Previously the absolute-positioned Nav (height 76, position:absolute bottom:0) sat above the ScrollView which had no bottom reservation, so at 375x667 the add-task Pressable rendered under the nav; taps were intercepted by the Review tab causing an unwanted setTab('Review'). Fix reserves 76px via ScrollView style marginBottom, so scroll content ends above the nav; add-task now receives taps naturally.
